summary.method: Incremental extension of inherited frozen census; baseline bytes and direct tables unchanged by exact Git comparison; fresh parse/canonicalization of added archives only.

inherited_summary.scope: All 32 top-level incoming ZIPs, recursively traversing each archive byte identity once; complete numeric binary .tm and .txt tables with one undefined halt target; direct PA .tm files. Code/JSON-embedded tables and a no-halt synthetic 4-state control are excluded. Graph classification excludes two disconnected synthetic controls.
